frozen_operator.name: SON_RETURN_PATH_PARENT_DELTA_CERTIFICATE
frozen_operator.law: A child residual may carry only the exact transition delta required to reconstruct its immediate parent residual and verify the branch forward again.
certificate_contents: clauses removed or changed by that branch
child clauses that are branch artifacts and must be removed during reconstruction
frozen_operator.generation_rule: The delta must be built in the same parent-clause pass that performs simplify_one semantics; no second parent residual scan is allowed for certificate generation.
frozen_operator.authorization_rule: A recovery delta can reconstruct and verify a parent transition only. It cannot authorize SAT, UNSAT, equivalence, absorption, pruning, or a semantic merge.

recovery_gates: every emitted child recovery delta reconstructs the exact immediate parent
every reconstructed parent forward-replays to the same child
every reconstructed parent matches its exact commitment
aggregate charged recovery-delta wire bytes are strictly less than aggregate full-parent snapshot wire bytes
certificate generation performs zero extra parent residual rescans

stop_rule: Any failed gate freezes this implementation as a negative result. No reinterpretation or threshold change after seeing the result.
claim_ceiling: A pass would establish only exact immediate-parent recovery with smaller aggregate certificate payload on this revealed calibration.
A pass would not establish lower total runtime or memory on arbitrary CNFs.
A pass would not establish a universal polynomial residual automaton.
